faqs.question: What happens to transparent areas in WebP?
faqs.answer: Because JPG does not support transparency, transparent areas are smoothly filled with a clean white or selected background color.

faqs.question: Are my images uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion is performed 100% locally in your web browser with zero server uploads.

faqs.question: Can I control the output JPG quality?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can adjust the quality slider from 10% to 100% (90% default for crisp photos with small file sizes).

faqs.question: Is JPG compatible with all devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. JPG is universally supported across every operating system, photo viewer, and printer.

faqs.question: What happens to transparent backgrounds when converting WebP to JPG?
faqs.answer: The JPEG standard does not support transparent alpha channels. Our converter automatically applies a clean solid white background behind transparent areas to prevent dark or black artifact boxes.

faqs.question: Will image quality decrease during WebP to JPG conversion?
faqs.answer: Our converter utilizes a high-quality 92% encoding threshold that preserves sharp edges and vibrant tones while keeping file weight manageable.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on how many WebP photos I can convert?
faqs.answer: No. The conversion executes entirely in your browser using local device memory, so there are no daily conversion caps or wait queues.

faqs.question: Why does my converted JPG fail to save?
faqs.answer: Check that your browser has permission to download files. If converting multiple large photos simultaneously, allow a few seconds for local canvas memory allocation.

faqs.answer: Ja, JPG ist das weltweit am weitesten verbreitete Bildformat.

faqs.question: Was geschieht mit transparenten Bereichen bei der JPG-Konvertierung?
faqs.answer: Das JPEG-Format unterstützt keine Transparenz. Das Tool hinterlegt transparente Zonen automatisch mit neutralem Weiß, um schwarze Ränder zu verhindern.

faqs.question: Verliert das Bild an Qualität?

faqs.question: Gibt es Beschränkungen bei der Anzahl der Umwandlungen?
